methodology: Identity-only universe expand batch 5. Prefer FOSS + XLN Audio + Modartt + Ignite/STL/ML Sound Lab/Two notes + Spitfire/EastWest soundset-or-bundle fills. New manufacturers: modartt, ignite-amps, stl-tones, ml-sound-lab, two-notes, fractal-audio, plugin-boutique, sample-magic, garritan, matt-tytel, thewavewarden, brain-control, dexed, distrho, jean-pierre-cimalando, headrush. XLN AdPaks/XOpaks → expansion; Keys instruments → soundset; hubs → hub_app. Ignite owns freeware amp sims; STL owns ToneHub/AmpHub/Tonality (cross-dedup). Two notes curated (KVR empty, site 403) — no DynIR SKU explosion. FOSS first-class twins of OAS rows (cross_mfr_dedup off for twins). Skipped: loopmasters, airwindows (dense), faold/minimal-system (empty KVR), boss tone studio (sparse), neural (dense), guitar-rig/amplitube/helix already. No invented versions.
